## Description

#### About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

#### About the team

Our Product Marketing team's mission is to generate customer insights that inform Stripe's product strategy, and lead go-to-market for our suite of products. Product Marketing is a highly cross-functional role at Stripe, partnering closely with Product and Engineering, Sales, Partnerships, Demand Generation and Campaigns to name a few. Different from many other Product Marketing teams, our team works across the entire product lifecycle, from helping shape the product, to driving launch and commercialization, to growing product adoption post-launch. We also drive both self-serve and sales-sold marketing efforts.

We are looking for an experienced product marketing leader to own our go-to-market strategy and grow adoption for Stripe Billing—which includes Subscriptions, Invoicing, and Metronome.

#### What you'll do

- Define and lead the go-to-market strategy for all Billing products, including segmentation, target audiences, positioning, launches, and post-launch adoption.
- Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of product marketers, setting clear priorities and raising the bar for strategic thinking, customer insight, and execution.
- Synthesize customer, market, and competitive insights to inform product strategy, roadmap prioritization, and differentiated commercialization plans.
- Develop clear, compelling positioning and messaging that translates complex revenue-management capabilities into value for executive and technical audiences.
- Partner with Sales, Partnerships, Demand Generation, and Campaigns to equip go-to-market teams with the narratives, enablement, and programs needed to engage enterprise customers effectively.
- Lead cross-functional teams through high-stakes launches and growth initiatives, aligning senior stakeholders around decisions, sequencing, and customer outcomes.
- Establish success metrics and use customer, sales, and product data to assess performance, identify growth opportunities, and improve go-to-market strategy over time.
- Represent the product area in executive narratives, customer conversations, and key industry moments, building credibility with enterprise audiences and internal leaders.

#### Minimum requirements

- 15+ years of product marketing experience, preferably in B2B technology
- 5+ years of experience managing teams, with a proven record of building and leading high-performing, highly cross-functional teams
- Deep experience marketing to enterprise audiences, with a demonstrated ability to understand complex buying committees, long sales cycles, and sophisticated business needs.
- High comfort toggling between big-picture strategy and detailed execution, with a strong bias to action.
- Excellent communication and presentation abilities, with a proven track record of explaining complex technical concepts in ways that executive, technical, and non-technical audiences can understand.

#### Preferred qualifications

- Experience in billing, payments, subscription management, financial operations, or an adjacent industry.
- Experience marketing to AI companies
